root_cause_analysis.symptom: The user's stated user-facing symptom is that prior fixes were made in /usr/lib/node_modules/rednote-mcp/dist/* (the install path) instead of /root/rednote-mcp/dist/* (the source-of-truth repo). Concretely: 21598 B of feature code orphaned in install path on rednoteTools.js; 753 B on cli.js; source repo carries no record of the substantive search_notes_light addition; manifest has 25 entries when it should have 26.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Architect-named anti-pattern: 'edit-the-installed-artifact instead of edit-the-source' (a sub-class of 'reverse-direction sync' / 'install-path-as-source-of-truth'). The orchestrator in the prior session edited the install path because (a) edits there have immediate observable effect with zero ceremony; (b) the source-of-truth direction (cd /root/rednote-mcp && edit && commit && deploy) was incomplete in MIGRATION-20260503.md — the doc explicitly defers 'deploy mechanism' to 'out of scope' (lines 36 + 67), so each deploy is improvised, which is how reverse-direction in-place edits leak in; (c) the working delta produced no immediate signal that source was stale (the symptom only appears at the next deploy/install/wipe). The structural root cause is the absence of a sanctioned deploy mechanism — without one, in-place edits are operationally easier than edit-then-deploy, which guarantees the anti-pattern recurs.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A (no commit landed for the orphaned delta — the commits are missing from /root/rednote-mcp git log; that is the symptom)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Working under deadline pressure or context-recovery shortcut, the prior orchestrator session needed search_notes_light to ship and verified it works against the live runtime by editing the runtime directly. The migration doc's 'cd /root/rednote-mcp && edit && commit' loop has only three verbs; the missing fourth verb (deploy) made the source-first path feel incomplete, so the install-first path was taken instead.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Inverts source-of-truth polarity: the install path (a deploy artifact) becomes the de facto upstream, the git-tracked repo becomes downstream and stale. Three concrete consequences: (1) any future npm install -g rednote-mcp from upstream registry would atomically replace dist/ and erase the working delta — the 2026-04-04 happy-server incident shape (CLAUDE.md global section), but for rednote-mcp; (2) git carries no record so any new orchestrator session reads the source repo as ground truth and proceeds from a stale baseline; (3) the audit trail (.stealth-applied-fragments manifest) goes out of sync with what's actually deployed, so future archeologists cannot attribute the 21598 B delta to any documented fragment.
